ref_date_note: M (Jun) contract, no roll mention (numbers match ESM5: 6/12 RTH high 6051 / low 6008.5). Older-format letter: 'Trades:' section is prose, ES only, all ungraded (tag ''); no NQ trades. Inside day 6/12; FOMC upcoming; author in 'round-tripper mode' (cautious on rips). ES today's high only given as the top/bottom of '6049.5-6051 Tuesday's high to today's high' -> es2 gated RTH_HIGH (resolves to 6051 on ESM5). Today's low not labelled numerically (letter says 6004-6008 'held at open (6008.5 low)') -> es4 target / es5 gate RTH_LOW, as in the 9/18 example. es1 targets 32/33 = 6032-6033 first (where he would take profit) then 6024-6028. es3 ('fair long back up') has no stated target -> 32/33 then today's high per commentary 'Holding above 24-28, especially once 32/33 reclaims, I would expect a retest of today's high'. es3 'sweeping 29' (single prints 6026.25-6029) kept only in quote. es5 'or the cluster of lows' not given a number -> gate RTH_LOW only. Commentary-only ideas not recorded as trades: long a sustained break above today's high / short a sustained break of today's low / fade failed breaks of the inside-day range. NQ cash-hours low 21818.5 kept as a level.

trades.name: Failed continuation above 6049.5-6051
trades.quote: Any failure to find continuation above 6049.5-6051 likely rotates toward 6024-6028 but given the prevailing bullish trend we could see bids come in before there. If I were short I would be prepared to cover, certainly taking profit by 32/33.

trades.name: LAAF of today's high
trades.quote: A look above and fail of today’s high is more likely to find its way to 32/33 and a proper test of 6024-6028.

trades.name: Failed breakdown / hold of 6024-6028
trades.quote: Any failure from sellers to get through 6024-6028 is a fair long back up. We have single prints from 6026.25-6029. Dipping into this range and sweeping 29 would seem like a setup for a rally.

trades.name: Reactive short on lower highs/lows below 6024-6028
trades.quote: I hate breakdown shorts in a bullish trend, so I won’t plan for a short below 6024-6028 but if we find ourselves with lower highs and lower lows below, I am okay taking a reactive short for a scalp toward today’s low.

trades.name: LBAF of today's low
trades.quote: A LBAF of today’s low or the cluster of lows still has to be a long, at least back to 6024-6028. Giving the prevailing bullish trend it is always fine to hold long runners until sellers prove a willingness to take out a prior day low.
